fullContent:
Panchsakar Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha – Page 589. 
 Introduction 
 Panchsakar Churna is an ayurvedic formulation that consists of five ingredients as its name describes. This medicine is known to have properties like laxative and purgative etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Swarnapatri – Cassia angustifolia 
 Shatapushpa – Anethum sowa 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Balaharitaki – Unripe fruits of Terminalia chebula 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients up to 10 gram and powder them. 
 Now mix all the powders to form Churna. 
 Dose 
 Take one to two grams with warm water or milk, at bedtime. 
 Indications 
 
 Bloating 
 Abdominal pain 
 Piles 
 Loss of appetite 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Constipation 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dose can cause diarrhea or gastric problem. 
 Precautions should be taking if suffering from high BP. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
